title: Won't engage gear, pickup, and door unlock issues
summary: This topic groups several unrelated 'won’t' complaints, including delayed downshifts with jerky acceleration, difficulty arranging vehicle pickup for service, and an insensitive door-unlock sensor, alongside phrase-only fragments that do not convey a clear evaluative aspect.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes the car not dropping into the lowest gear until throttle input, causing a jerky lurch forward.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments include ambiguous 'won't be my last' statements plus isolated complaints about service pickup and door unlocking that are too limited to summarize as a consistent sentiment pattern.

limitations: This cluster mixes unrelated subjects rather than one coherent issue.
